report:
Reviewed the complete fresh crates.sage_ir.types.lifetimes.dummy claim, all six implementation associations and five tests. Requirements include explicit, elided, universal, existential, imported and synthesized lifetime origins; every origin lowers to Dummy. Dummy is deliberately not static, not a lifetime inference variable and not post-analysis region erasure; this omission must not introduce ambiguity. Captured design/RFD context and test dependencies, verifying reused helper fragments against their previously inspected exact contents.

Implementation: ty.rs defines Lifetime with only Dummy and documents deferred lifetime inference/borrow checking. cst/ty.rs discards the source lifetime when lowering Reference and constructs Dummy immediately; check/expr.rs does the same for body type syntax and for reference expressions. external_syms.rs lowers RawTy::Ref to Dummy while recursively lowering its referent. local_syms/fns.rs creates Dummy for reference receiver parameters. infer_ctx.rs adjust_method_receiver creates an explicit reference expression and Dummy reference type for autoref. These cover distinct local, imported and synthesized construction sites. The dedicated single variant and immediate lowering distinguish omission from static or a later erasure phase. They do not supply exhaustive behavioral tests for every lifetime origin.

Ordinary explicit_elided_and_static_lifetimes_collapse_to_dummy checks a signature with named universal lifetime, elided reference and static return reference. It iterates both parameters and return type, requiring Ty::Ref with Dummy, and checks parameter-environment solver eligibility. It is signature evidence, not a test of the function body's borrow validity. lifetime_generic_impl_uses_dummy_and_remains_solver_eligible checks a lifetime-generic impl's Self reference is Dummy and its solver eligibility remains Eligible. These directly support lifetime omission without rejecting those signatures as unsupported; they do not establish a full solver ambiguity matrix.

Ordinary comparisons_materialize_signature_required_shared_borrows requires no body diagnostics for equality and ordering, resolved trait calls with expected names, Bool result and two explicit shared-reference operands, each typed with Dummy. The clone_method_call_is_elaborated_to_a_resolved_trait_call fixture requires a diagnostic-free Clone call and traverses the synthesized receiver, explicitly asserting its reference type uses Dummy and that field/dereference/local nodes remain. These provide direct synthesized-reference evidence; they are not exhaustive imported/bound/inferred-origin tests. The helper database fixtures supply actual source checking, Clone metadata or live external metadata, and the assertions inspect the returned Sage tree. Symbol-name helpers do actual name comparisons. The comparison helper invokes the callback twice; this is not credited as separate full lifetime-origin coverage.

The TODO types_lifetimes_dummy contains no assertions and explicitly retains imported, bound and inferred-origin tests beyond local explicit/elided/static and synthesized cases. This is justified: external lowering exists, but these ordinary tests do not directly enumerate externally imported lifetime origins or existential/bound provenance. Replacing it requires origin-specific fixtures and evidence that lifetime omission itself neither creates ambiguity nor leaves lifetime inference variables. Existing generic-impl eligibility and diagnostic-free calls support a limited slice only. No N/A exception is applied to universal/existential cases, and the intentional omission is not reinterpreted as static semantics or completed borrow analysis.

Validation was source inspection of fresh inputs and captured dependencies. No source edits or behavioral tests were performed; coordinator-run suites remain separate execution evidence. No requested edits: implementation sites and ordinary assertions support the present slice, while the explicit TODO preserves the complete lifetime-origin and ambiguity coverage gap.
